Sandbox_DeathZoneEnabled_tooltip: Stops a player from using Spawn Selector to spawn back near where their previous character died, making it harder to immediately reclaim lost gear with a fresh character.
Sandbox_DeathZoneRadius_tooltip: How far, in tiles, the no-spawn zone extends around a player's death location.
Sandbox_DeathZoneDurationHours_tooltip: How many real-world hours the block lasts after death. Set to 0 to block the area permanently.
Sandbox_AllowWeaponsMilitary: Allow Spawning in Weapon & Military Buildings
Sandbox_AllowWeaponsMilitary_tooltip: Gun stores, shooting ranges, army surplus stores and other military buildings. Untick to stop Spawn Selector from placing players inside these.
Sandbox_AllowMedical_tooltip: Hospitals, doctors' offices, dentists, pharmacies, nursing homes and laboratories.
Sandbox_AllowLawEnforcement: Allow Spawning in Law Enforcement Buildings
Sandbox_AllowLawEnforcement_tooltip: Police stations, prisons and fire stations.
Sandbox_AllowRetailShops_tooltip: General stores, malls, clothing stores, electronics stores, gas stations, and other retail shops.
Sandbox_AllowFoodDrink_tooltip: Restaurants, cafes, bars, bakeries and other food and drink venues.
Sandbox_AllowResidentialLodging_tooltip: Houses, motels, hotels and trailer parks.
Sandbox_AllowCivicPublic: Allow Spawning in Civic & Public Buildings
Sandbox_AllowCivicPublic_tooltip: Churches, schools, libraries, offices and post offices.
Sandbox_AllowRecreation_tooltip: Gyms, theatres, bowling alleys, swimming pools and other entertainment venues.
Sandbox_GiveBuildingKey: Give Player a Key to Their Spawn Building
Sandbox_GiveBuildingKey_tooltip: If the building a player spawns in has a lock, automatically give them a matching key for it so they aren't locked in or out of their own starting building.
Sandbox_ShowPOIs_tooltip: Displays marked points of interest on the spawn-selection map. Untick to hide the POI button and all POI markers from players.
